description:
Cause a noncreature artifact to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Dan Lewis if it isn't an Equipment already, causing Barret to trigger.
Resolve Barret's first ability, creating a 2/2 red Rebel creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature, creating a Blood token which will be an Equipment due to Dan Lewis, and causing Barret to trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
